type.notes: Serialized as the state type field.

base.notes: Serialized when present. Loaded resolved variants normally omit this authoring-only field.

id.notes: Serialized when present and required to distinguish resolved variants.
Used to derive mesh asset keys, not stored as a top-level character id.

name.notes: Display name is editor-facing and not present in FSPK v1.

properties.notes: Stored in CHARACTER_PROPS; nested values are flattened to dotted property names.

input.notes: Stored in STATE_EXTRAS as input notation. FSPK v1 does not separately store resolved variant id.

name.notes: Display name is editor-facing and not present in FSPK v1.

damage.notes: Stored in StateRecord and copied into legacy hit windows.

hitstun.notes: Stored in StateRecord and copied into legacy hit windows.

blockstun.notes: Stored in StateRecord and copied into legacy hit windows.

hitstop.notes: Stored in StateRecord and copied into legacy hit windows.

guard.notes: Stored in StateRecord and legacy hit windows as an enum value.

hitboxes.notes: Legacy rectangular hitboxes are stored as HIT_WINDOWS plus SHAPES.

hurtboxes.notes: Legacy rectangular hurtboxes are stored as HURT_WINDOWS plus SHAPES.

pushback.notes: Stored on legacy hit windows as fixed-point hit/block pushback.

meter_gain.notes: Exported as meter resource deltas when nonzero and not already declared.

animation.notes: Mapped to MESH_KEYS and KEYFRAMES_KEYS indices.

type.notes: Known types are encoded in StateRecord and also emitted as state tags; unknown custom types encode as 255 in StateRecord.

trigger.notes: Stored in StateRecord as an enum value.

parent.notes: Follow-up ownership remains engine-side in FSPK v1.

total.notes: Stored in StateRecord; derived from startup+active+recovery when omitted.

hits.notes: The advanced multi-hit model is not exported by FSPK v1; legacy hitboxes are exported instead.

preconditions.notes: Resource preconditions are stored; meter, charge, state, grounded, airborne, health, entity_count, combo_count, opponent_state, and distance variants are not represented in FSPK v1.

costs.notes: Resource costs are stored; meter and health costs are not represented in FSPK v1.

movement.notes: Authored movement is not represented in FSPK v1; runtime movement ownership is still a production blocker.

on_use.notes: Events and resource_deltas are stored; enters_state, spawn_entity, and gain_meter are not represented in FSPK v1.

on_hit.notes: Events and resource_deltas are stored; gain_meter, heal, status, knockback, wall_bounce, and ground_bounce are not represented in FSPK v1.

on_block.notes: Events and resource_deltas are stored; gain_meter and pushback are not represented in FSPK v1.

advanced_hurtboxes.notes: Advanced shaped hurtboxes and flags are not represented in FSPK v1; legacy hurtboxes are exported.

properties.notes: Stored in STATE_PROPS; nested values are flattened to dotted property names.

base.notes: Authoring-only inheritance field; variants should be flattened before FSPK export.

id.notes: FSPK v1 does not store resolved variant id separately from gameplay input. This is a known limitation for variant-heavy runtime handoff.

tag_rules.notes: Stored in CANCEL_TAG_RULES. Selector resolution is currently based on input/type/tags.

deny.notes: Stored in CANCEL_DENIES as state index pairs. Current exporter resolves deny entries by gameplay input.
